PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE

CHARTS:
* Title: Assets by Type Comparison for FY 2024 and FY 2023 (IN MILLIONS)
  * Type: Stacked bar chart
  * Units: Millions of dollars
  * Legend/Categories: Other (purple), Property, Plant, and Equipment (blue), Fund Balance with Treasury (green)
  * Labeled Values:
    * 2024 Total ($27,504): Other $987; Property, Plant, and Equipment $9,331; Fund Balance with Treasury $17,186
    * 2023 Total ($26,135): Other $106; Property, Plant, and Equipment $8,651; Fund Balance with Treasury $17,378

* Title: Assets by Type 2024 (IN MILLIONS)
  * Type: Donut chart
  * Units: Millions of dollars
  * Center text: TOTAL ASSETS $27,504
  * Labeled Values/Slices:
    * Property, Plant, and Equipment: 34%, $9,331
    * Other: 4%, $987
    * Fund Balance with Treasury: 62%, $17,186

KEY FACTS:
* NASA’s total asset balance as of September 30, 2024, was $27.5 billion, five percent higher than FY 2023.
* Total Assets were the largest of the three categories (Total Liabilities plus Total Net Position will always equal Total Assets).
* Fund Balance with Treasury (FBWT) was the largest asset at $17 billion, accounting for 62 percent of total assets.
* NASA’s Property, Plant, and Equipment (PP&E) had a net book value of $9.3 billion as of September 30, 2024, 34 percent of total assets or an eight percent increase as compared to FY 2023.
* The Other category represents Accounts Receivable, Advances and Prepayments, and Investments as of September 30, 2024.
* The Other category increased by $881 million.
